[EVENT] User requested tips on how to properly clean and maintain their new Instant Pot and kitchen knives.  
[ASSISTANT] Provided cleaning and maintenance tips for the Instant Pot, including cleaning after each use, soaking accessories, descaling every 3-6 months, cleaning the seal and gasket, drying thoroughly, and proper storage.  
[ASSISTANT] Provided cleaning and maintenance tips for kitchen knives, including hand washing, drying immediately, proper storage, regular sharpening, honing, and cleaning the handle.  
[EVENT] User requested advice on meal planning and grocery shopping to reduce food waste.  
[ASSISTANT] Provided meal planning tips, including planning meals for the week, creating a meal calendar, considering one-pot meals, using a "cook once, eat twice" approach, and involving family in meal planning.  
[ASSISTANT] Provided grocery shopping tips, including making a grocery list, shopping the pantry first, buying in bulk, shopping for seasonal produce, and avoiding overbuying.  
[ASSISTANT] Provided tips for reducing food waste, including using up leftovers, storing food properly, freezing ingredients, composting, and shopping for imperfect produce.  
[EVENT] User requested advice on organizing kitchen utensils and spices.  
[ASSISTANT] Provided tips for organizing kitchen utensils, including purging and decluttering, categorizing and grouping utensils, assigning a home for each category, using vertical space, storing heavy items near the floor, and keeping frequently used items accessible.  
[ASSISTANT] Provided tips for organizing spices, including purging and decluttering, categorizing and grouping spices, choosing a storage method, storing spices away from heat and light, and keeping frequently used spices accessible.
